story: Leonardo Martínez Moya founded the company together with other former dancers and teachers of the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba.

Our aim is to teach, share and preserve traditional Cuban folkloric dance. Under the direction of Leonardo Martínez Moya and Giuliana Cassarisi, the maestros pass on what they learned in Havana to dancers and musicians from many countries.
In this way, the company is also a tribute to the Cuban people, and to the maestros, dancers and musicians who carried Cuban culture around the world before us.

pillars.title: International dancers
pillars.text: Dancers from all over Europe and beyond, brought together by Cuban dance.

pillars.title: Training on the move
pillars.text: Every month we meet for a training weekend in a different European city.

pillars.title: Technique and choreography
pillars.text: Regular classes in technique and repertoire, and rehearsals for our shows.

pillars.title: Performances
pillars.text: We perform at festivals, cultural events and on tour.

pillars.title: Collaborations
pillars.text: We work with other artists, choreographers and musicians on new productions.

pillars.title: Community
pillars.text: Workshops and events that bring in local dancers wherever we go.

mission: We want to protect and share Cuba's dance and music traditions through performances, workshops and work with other artists.
Teaching is at the centre of what we do. Our programmes pass on Cuban dance technique and folklore to new generations of dancers in Europe.
We also document traditional Cuban dances, including choreographies, music and costumes, so that they can be passed on.

exchange.title: Cultural exchange with Cuba
exchange.text: We regularly travel to Havana for our Encuentros. There we train with the maestros of the Conjunto Folklórico Nacional de Cuba and of Conjunto Ban Rarrá. In 2024 and 2025 we spent two weeks of classes in Havana and saw the Conjunto’s anniversary show.

paths.title: Academy
paths.text: Everyone starts in the academy. You learn the dances in depth, at your own pace, and you can stay as long as you like, even if you can't come every month.

paths.title: Company
paths.text: Company members perform on stage across Europe. After at least three training weekends, the teachers decide if you join the company or stay in the academy a little longer. Members come every month and also rehearse at home.
